lines.text: Many learners say: How much people are here?
Better: How many people are here?
We can count people, so we say many.
The second! How many people are here?

data.why: We can count people, so we say many.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “quanta gente”, mas em inglês “people” se conta: use “how many”.
native.caption: Você também diz isso? “How much people are here?” 😅 O certo é “How many people are here?” Em português dizemos “quanta gente”, mas em inglês “people” se conta: use “how many”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “many”. Agora diga em voz alta “How many people are here?” e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese we say “quanta gente”, but in English “people” can be counted: use “how many”.
en.caption: Do you say this too? “How much people are here?” 😅 The right way is “How many people are here?” In Portuguese we say “quanta gente”, but in English “people” can be counted: use “how many”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
